sentences.text: S1 (Aisha Bello) identified as a mental health social worker from the community mental health team; S2 (Callum Reid) attended the appointment because his GP, Dr Shah, requested the
S2 (Callum Reid) stated he has been feeling 'rubbish' since about the summer and dropped out of college in September after studying Engineering at Level three
S2 (Callum Reid) reported sleeping badly, staying up until four or five in the morning gaming, then sleeping during the day
S2 (Callum Reid) reported eating not much, mostly toast, with his mum leaving food
S2 (Callum Reid) disclosed he has asthma and uses an inhaler
S2 (Callum Reid) stated he was working at a warehouse as a Christmas temp last year but has no work now; his mum has been urging him to sign on
S2 (Callum Reid) reported his mum works a lot as a nurse mostly at night, they don't really talk about stuff, and she knows he is down but not the rest of it
S2 (Callum Reid) stated he does not really talk to friends, except online with his mate Josh, and his sister is at university in Leeds
S2 (Callum Reid) disclosed he cuts his arms, stating 'Most nights. For about two months now'
S2 (Callum Reid) reported the cuts are not deep, are all right, and he keeps his sleeves down
S2 (Callum Reid) disclosed he has wanted to die 'properly' for the last few weeks
S2 (Callum Reid) disclosed he went to Calder Bridge over the river last week, stood there thinking about jumping off, but walked home
S2 (Callum Reid) stated his mum and his dog, Bailey (a staffy, three years old who sleeps on his bed), stopped him from jumping off the bridge
S2 (Callum Reid) denied taking an overdose of tablets or anything, stating 'No. Never. I've never done that'
S2 (Callum Reid) reported he has no tablets stored up in the flat, only his mum's paracetamol in the kitchen
S2 (Callum Reid) stated today is okay and he is not going to do anything today
S1 (Aisha Bello) proposed telling S2's mum, and S2 (Callum Reid) agreed, stating 'Yeah. Okay'
S1 (Aisha Bello) agreed to ring the crisis team as soon as she leaves to arrange a visit for S2 (Callum Reid) tomorrow
S1 (Aisha Bello) agreed to ring S2's mum with him at six tonight
S1 (Aisha Bello) agreed to book a practice nurse to look at S2's arms on Thursday the twenty-sixth
S1 (Aisha Bello) agreed to return to see S2 (Callum Reid) on Monday the thirtieth
S1 (Aisha Bello) proposed looking at Universal Credit and getting back to college, with S2 (Callum Reid) responding 'Yeah, maybe'
S1 (Aisha Bello) advised that if things get bad before the agreed actions, S2 (Callum Reid) should ring the crisis line, call 999, or go to A&E
